description: This file defines a Java class 'CreateDelinquencyRangeCommandHandler' responsible for handling commands to create delinquency ranges in the Fineract application. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface, processes commands via a service, and is annotated for dependency injection and command typing.

classes.name: CreateDelinquencyRangeCommandHandler
classes.description: A handler class for processing commands to create delinquency ranges, wired with a service to perform the operation, and annotated with command type and transaction management.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming command to create a delinquency range by delegating to the write platform service within a transaction.
